function relocate_blocked_scene_targets!(env;)
    zone_keys = Symbol[first(entry) for entry in active_restriction_zones()]
    isempty(zone_keys) && error("no active restriction zone was found")

    restage = restage_all_blocked!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys)
    if restage.status in (:partial, :residual_blocked, :infeasible)
        translated = translate_whole_build!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys)
        translated.status in (:translated, :already_clear) ||
            error("unable to produce accessible scene geometry")
    elseif !(restage.status in (:restaged_all, :none))
        error("unexpected restaging result")
    end

    blockage = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
    blockage.checked_paths || error("route reachability was not checked")
    blockage.n_blocked == 0 || error("navigating goals remain blocked")
    blockage.n_disconnected == 0 || error("a required route remains disconnected")
    blockage.n_engulfed == 0 || error("a required goal remains engulfed")
    blockage.project_blocked == false || error("ProjectComplete remains unreachable")

    for zone_key in zone_keys
        diagnosis = zone_diagnosis(
            env,
            zone_key;
            check_restage = true,
            check_teams = true,
            check_blockage = true,
            check_paths = true,
        )
        diagnosis.exists || error("active restriction zone disappeared")
        diagnosis.n_nav_blocked == 0 ||
            error("a navigating goal remains inaccessible")
        diagnosis.n_teams_covered == 0 ||
            error("a forming transport team still has an inaccessible gathering location")
    end

    validate_schedule_transform_tree(env.sched) ||
        error("staging, deposit, and lift transforms are inconsistent")

    return (; status = :success)
end
